# Natural-language cases supported in phase 4.
#
# Format:
#   -- <case name>
#   input: <human phrasing>
#   reply: <the single submit_intent tool call the model is expected to produce>
#   argv:  <expected final OCR argv>   (intent case)
#   kind:  clarify | reject            (non-intent case)
#
# The input lines carry non-English phrasing on purpose. This file is .txt, which
# scripts/verify-english-only.go does not scan, and testdata/ is ignored by the
# license check, so no SPDX header is needed here. The test feeds each reply to a
# scripted fake LLM and asserts the deterministic layer produces the same result,
# which keeps this catalog honest.

-- review workspace
input: 评审当前改动
reply: {"action":"review","review":{"type":"workspace"}}
argv: review --format json --audience human --color never

-- review range
input: 以 main 为基线评审 feature 分支
reply: {"action":"review","review":{"type":"range","from":"main","to":"feature"}}
argv: review --from main --to feature --format json --audience human --color never

-- review commit
input: 评审提交 abc1234
reply: {"action":"review","review":{"type":"commit","commit":"abc1234"}}
argv: review --commit abc1234 --format json --audience human --color never

-- scan path
input: 扫描 internal/agent
reply: {"action":"scan","scan":{"paths":["internal/agent"]}}
argv: scan --path internal/agent --format json --audience human --color never

-- scan root
input: 扫描整个仓库
reply: {"action":"scan","scan":{}}
argv: scan --format json --audience human --color never

-- clarify missing refs
input: 比较两个分支
reply: {"action":"clarify","question":"Which two refs should I compare?","missing":["from","to"],"review":{"type":"range"}}
kind: clarify

-- reject staged only
input: 只评审暂存区
reply: {"action":"reject","reason":"the CLI cannot review only the staged area","hint":"Use /review for the whole change set, or stage nothing."}
kind: reject

-- reject auto fix
input: 帮我修复这些问题
reply: {"action":"reject","reason":"this adapter only reviews; it does not edit code","hint":"Ask for a review instead."}
kind: reject
